summary: Frontend-only public-preview Chromium review: 64/64 scoped checks passed for TR/EN at 1920x1080 and 390x844. Centered sticky-transition notch, reverse scrolling, localized foundations metrics/CTA, header, arrow, first register navigation, video progression, reduced motion and project-page isolation verified.
action_items: No scoped fixes required. Validate physical iOS/Safari and production/cPanel separately if needed; this run covers preview Chromium only.
critical_code_review_comments: No blocking defect identified in the changed notch/foundations implementation. Content clip-path retains centered downward vertex; sticky rule is limited to home wrapper and no-preference motion.

Existing maintainability debt: styles.css and script.js exceed 700 lines; homepage HTML is approximately 702 lines. Consider extracting homepage motion/foundations styles and interaction modules separately.

Existing testability debt outside new section: several project links, carousel/cookie controls and register form inputs lack data-testid. New foundations section and its CTA/metrics have test IDs. No application code modified.
seed_data_creation: None. No form submissions, account changes or database writes. No MOCKED APIs or integrations.

Computed content polygon has calc(50% +/-20px), 50%18px desktop and +/-15px, 50%14px mobile, matching existing hero notch variables. Reverse native wheel returns scrollY0 and content origin819.59/610.52. Header dark rgba(11,11,11,.94) with white controls over white content. Mobile CTA and each metric can be centered between headerBottom85 and bottomBarTop775; center hit test confirms no interception and overflow0. Reduced motion both widths/languages yields relative heroTop-300 after wheel300. Main browser run recorded no console/page errors or DOM error messages. Screenshots reviewed for both desktop sections and mobile notch/editorial copy. Backend APIs, form submission, physical iOS, Safari and production deployment excluded.
rca of the issue: Requested notch preservation is confirmed: the opaque covering content itself now has a downward triangular cutout matching the original hero-bottom dimensions, leaving video visible at the centered transition edge. No unresolved scoped failure reproduced.
